absolute-path.json.description: artifacts[0].relative_path is an absolute path instead of a portable relative path.

extra-property.json.description: Top-level payload carries an undeclared property forbidden by additionalProperties: false.

invalid-id.json.description: manifest_id does not match the manifest:sha256:<64 lowercase hex> pattern.

invalid-timestamp.json.description: created_at_utc uses a non-UTC offset instead of the mandatory Z suffix.

missing-required-field.json.description: Required top-level property project is absent.

secret-like-field.json.description: Top-level payload carries an undeclared, secret-like-named property (api_token).

secret-like-value.json.description: producer.component carries a secret-like value pattern (api_token=secret).

wrong-schema-identity.json.description: manifest_schema_id does not equal the constant rcc002.dataset-manifest.

wrong-schema-version.json.description: manifest_schema_version does not equal the constant 1.0.1.

wrong-type-nullability.json.description: project is null instead of the required non-nullable string constant.

duplicate-view.json.description: views[2] duplicates views[1] (backtest-inputs); the distinct paper view is absent.

missing-view.json.description: views[4] duplicates views[3] (live); the distinct label-research view is absent.

reordered-view.json.description: All six registered views are present but views[0] and views[1] are transposed.

unknown-view.json.description: views[5] references an unregistered schema_id (rcc002.view.experimental) instead of audit/2.0.0.

wrong-view-allowlist-hash.json.description: views[0] (research-features) carries the 534-field allowlist hash instead of its own 232-field hash.

duplicate-specification.json.description: specification_profile[2] duplicates specification_profile[1] (RCC-002-DV); RCC-002-IS is absent.

missing-specification.json.description: specification_profile[4] duplicates specification_profile[3] (RCC-002-ST); RCC-002-RG is absent.

reordered-specification.json.description: All seven profile documents are present but positions 0 and 1 are transposed.

unknown-specification.json.description: specification_profile[3] references an unregistered document id (RCC-002-XX) instead of RCC-002-ST.

stale-specification-version.json.description: specification_profile[1] (RCC-002-DV) declares stale version 0.5.0 instead of the current 0.6.0.
